acs.text: Main regression: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the full test suite, Playwright included, on every pull request and every push to main, in job web; the deploy job needs it.
acs.raw_artifact:
::xpm-ac AC10::
--- triggers
pull_request:
  # edited: the denylist reads the PR title, which a squash merge writes into main's history, so
  # a title changed without a push must re-run every job. Skipping jobs on a body-only edit would
  # report ci-ok as skipped, which GitHub counts as passing over an earlier red run.
  types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]
push:
  branches: [main, 'xpm/land/**']
exit=0
--- web job steps
mise run web:install
mise run web:lint
mise run web:test
mise run web:build
mise run web:e2e-install
mise run web:e2e
--- deploy needs
[repo, web, infra]
--- web:test / web:e2e tasks
[tasks."web:test"]
description = "Unit tests and build checks"
dir = "apps/web"
run = "npm test"

[tasks."web:e2e-install"]
description = "Install the Chromium that the browser specs use"
dir = "apps/web"
run = "npx playwright install --with-deps chromium"

[tasks."web:e2e"]
description = "Browser specs against the production build"
dir = "apps/web"
run = "npm run e2e"

--- needs contains web?
true
deploy-needs-web exit=0
--- negative: contains a bogus job?
false
Error: no matches found
bogus exit=1 (nonzero expected)
--- e2e step present
run: mise run web:e2e
e2e exit=0
--- no job-level if on web
false
--- ADR
---
status: accepted
date: 2026-11-27
---
acs.verdict_reason: Triggers include pull_request and push to main; job web runs web:test and web:e2e unconditionally; deploy needs [repo, web, infra]; negative probe of a bogus need returned false.
